description: This file defines the MarketplaceManager class responsible for managing marketplace items, including fetching, filtering, installing, removing, and checking installations, with integrations to VSCode API, cloud services, and local configuration files.

classes.name: MarketplaceManager
classes.description: Manages marketplace items including retrieval, filtering, installation, removal, and metadata checking.

methods.name: getMarketplaceItems
methods.description: Fetches marketplace items, including organization-specific and general items, handling errors.

methods.name: getCurrentItems
methods.description: Returns combined list of organization and marketplace items.

methods.name: filterItems
methods.description: Filters marketplace items based on type, search term, and tags.

methods.name: updateWithFilteredItems
methods.description: Retrieves items filtered by specified criteria.

methods.name: installMarketplaceItem
methods.description: Installs a marketplace item, shows progress, and captures telemetry.

methods.name: removeInstalledMarketplaceItem
methods.description: Removes an installed marketplace item and captures telemetry.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Clears cached data in config loader.

methods.name: getInstallationMetadata
methods.description: Checks local configuration files for installed items and returns metadata.

methods.name: checkProjectInstallations
methods.description: Checks for project-level installed modes, MCPs, and skills.

methods.name: checkGlobalInstallations
methods.description: Checks for global-level installed modes, MCPs, and skills.
